summary: Oncotelic Therapeutics filed an 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 covering scientific presentations made October 7-8, 2026 at Drug Discovery 2026 in Burlingame, California, rather than any transactional event. The company described its PDAOAI literature-search platform, an exploratory four-gene mTOR-related signature associated with overall survival in retrospective analyses, and a BIO REBOOT initiative offering potential startup funding and development support to selected research projects. The disclosures are furnished under Item 8.01 and expressly not deemed filed under Section 18. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated, so no deal-terms or risk-arbitrage angle applies.
